evals.prompt: Here is a front and side turnaround of a knight character (ref/knight_front.png, ref/knight_side.png). Build him in Blender as a game-ready character for a third-person action game in Unity, about 1.85 m tall, rigged, with LOD0 to LOD2. Don't ask me questions unless you really have to.
evals.expected_output: asset-brief.md with measured proportions; CH_Knight master with calibration; blockout and forms compare sheets with IoU numbers from the reference camera; LOW meshes passing validate.py within budget; baked textures; DEF rig with hand sockets; GLB per LOD with asset-manifest.json; roundtrip report; final report listing inferred parts

evals.prompt: Recreate this dune buggy from the concept (ref/buggy_concept.jpg) as a drivable vehicle asset for Godot. Separate wheels with proper pivots, doors that open, a collision hull, GLB export.
evals.expected_output: vehicle brief with wheelbase, track, wheel diameter and clearance estimated from cues; lofted body shell; wheels as separate objects with origins at the axle; hinge pivots on doors; COL_ hull; sockets for seats and exhaust; steering-lock and suspension pose sheet; manifest listing inferred underside

evals.prompt: I have a photo of a stone chapel (ref/chapel.jpg). I need a modular kit I can snap together on a 2 m grid in three.js: walls, window wall, doorway, corner, pillar, arch, roof segment, plus the door as a separate hinged object. Tileable materials with a trim sheet.
evals.expected_output: architecture brief with storey height, opening rhythm and wall thickness from door and step cues; kit pieces with origins at grid corners and shared thickness constants; 2x2 assembly render with no seams; door pivot at the hinge; simple colliders; tileable UV scale checked against the ruler; GLB kit with manifest

evals.prompt: Attached are a character model sheet (ref/ranger_sheet.png: front, side and back views plus face and belt detail panels in one image) and a separate painted three-quarter concept (ref/ranger_concept.jpg). Build her in Blender as a game-ready hero character for Unreal, about 1.70 m tall, rigged, with LOD0 and LOD1.
evals.expected_output: asset-brief.md listing each panel of the sheet with its pixel box, scale and ground line; the front, side and back panels cropped into separate reference files that share one scale; the three-quarter concept used for silhouette and surface detail only, never proportions; world-registered gate IoU per orthographic view on cleaned mattes; conflicts between the sheet's views recorded as deviations; rigged GLB per LOD with a manifest listing inferred parts
